Game Overview

At its heart, Cowboy is a shooter game about saddle up as a fearless cowboy battling vicious bandits across dusty towns and wild canyons. Engage in adrenaline-pumping shootouts, testing your reflexes to determine the West's fate. Will you forge your legacy as a mere hero or an enduring legend? The frontier awaits your mark.

Each session of Cowboy follows a consistent rhythm. Saddle up as a fearless cowboy battling vicious bandits across dusty towns and wild canyons. Engage in adrenaline-pumping shootouts, testing your reflexes to determine the West's fate. Will you forge your legacy as a mere hero or an enduring legend? The frontier awaits your mark.
